title: scleranthus annuus subsp. tauricus
intro: Scleranthus annuus subsp. tauricus, commonly known as the Greek button, is a plant species in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae) that is native to the Mediterranean region. The health benefits of Scleranthus annuus subsp. tauricus include its potential use in reducing anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which are thought to be mediated by its ability to modulate the activity of neurotransmitters in the brain. The bioactive constituents of Scleranthus annuus subsp. tauricus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that are believed to contribute to its therapeutic effects.
